THE NON-NEGOTIABLES

Four rules that matter more than speed.

  1. 01

    Get out of traffic. A tow is cheaper than working beside fast-moving vehicles.

  2. 02

    Secure the car. Flat ground, parking brake, correct gear, and wheel chocks.

  3. 03

    Support it correctly. Never put any part of yourself under a car held only by a jack.

  4. 04

    Stop when unsure. A manual, experienced helper, or professional is a smart tool—not a defeat.
